{{Top|leg}}
'''Yiggott''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While handling a [[MSD-36 heavy disruptor pistol]], Yiggott suffered a burned hand after holstering the weapon due to the flash-heat from the barrel.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
